Group voxel-pair BWAS on clean 2 mm BIDS BOLD

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --bids-root BIDS_ROOT
                        BIDS Derivatives root
  --participants PARTICIPANTS
                        TSV with participant_id and model columns
  --mask MASK           2 mm standard-space NIfTI analysis mask
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                        empty BIDS Derivatives output directory
  --phenotype PHENOTYPE
                        binary or continuous target column
  --covariate COVARIATE
                        numeric covariate column; repeat
  --cdt CDT             absolute z cluster threshold
  --block-size BLOCK_SIZE
                        voxel tile edge length; GPU auto if omitted
  --subject-block-size SUBJECT_BLOCK_SIZE
                        subjects per GPU batch; GPU auto if omitted
  --column-tiles {1,2}  column tiles sharing a row; GPU auto if omitted
  --gpu-row-cache, --no-gpu-row-cache
                        keep the current cohort row on GPU; auto if omitted
  --num-workers NUM_WORKERS
                        parallel BOLD preparation workers
  --cache-root CACHE_ROOT
                        optional local directory for temporary voxel-major
                        BOLD cache
  --device DEVICE       PyTorch device
  --fwhm FWHM           optional known spatial smoothness in voxels
  --validate-direct-ols
                        compare every voxel pair with unbatched OLS; high host
                        RAM use
